activity.notes: Paul was a historical first-century Jewish and Roman figure whose letters provide direct evidence for his missionary and community-building activity across the Roman Empire. The beginning of his apostolic career and the date of his death are not precisely fixed; ATLAS uses c.35–c.67 CE as a representative interval.

sources.title: Paul, St — Oxford Classical Dictionary
sources.citation_text: Oxford identifies Paul as a Roman citizen from Tarsus whose authentic letters document his work among early Christian communities across major Roman urban centres.
